author: Squiggly Hair Shanks
text:
social media addiction

my average screen time last week across laptop and phone was 9 hrs 40 min

this is significantly above the global average. i sleep around 8 hours a day, which leaves a mere 6 hours every day for non-screen related activities. if you then subtract the default activities of eating 2 meals, using the bathroom, showering, getting to places, etc i realistically only spend 2 - 3 hours NOT on the screen

that's too much

if i wasn't a handsome, strong, successful multi millionaire, this lifestyle would be considered problematic by any health professional

even worse, my screen time is not productive. it's mainly doomscrolling, slaughtering civilians in speed chess or looking at my leverage position every 5 min. even worse, it inhibits my ability to do productive deep work, the only work that produces outlier returns for me. i can be LESS online and SIGNIFICANTLY more productive AND have more time to do fun stuff in nature, which i love

another problem is that the cheap dopamine hits of social media and gambling make everything else in life less interesting. a beautiful hike in nature for 4 hours becomes boring when you have a $20k bet on a ufc fight or a $1.5 mil position open on hyperliquid. nothing hits as hard as a big hand in blackjack, but that's not a good way of life

i am not a victim here. life is great and everything is self induced, i just rather chill on my phone than do harder stuff that have much better long term returns. but it's time to get my screen time down to 5 hours a day, which is my ideal
